odyn.title: Fast browser goals
odyn.description: Let agents hand a whole browser goal ("sign in and open settings") to Jev in one step, instead of clicking through it. Needs a Jev API key.
odyn.author: Odyn

preferences.name: textModel
preferences.title: Model for typing into fields (optional, e.g. claude-haiku-4-5; empty uses the chat's model)

agent.summary: hand a whole browser goal to Jev in one step, in chats where the user asked for the browser
